title: GIRDER NEW 2025 FAME PRO
notes: Exact FAME PRO page (Chinese-language spec table) lists ¥28,800; T800 + T1000 BB-reinforced aero frame, EPS, hidden routing, '五通 BSA' in the frame line but T47 P1.0 84.5 mm + 2×1 mm shims in the BB row, 12 mm thru-axles, UDH, separate Shimano battery storage; ADLER AUGEN 2025 aero bar 6° offset; 3D-printed carbon-rail saddle; Dura-Ace R9270 Di2, FC-R9200 52-36T 170 mm, CS-R9200 11-34T, CN-M9100; Golden Eagle 60 mm carbon wheels; Maxxis 28C; weight 7.86 kg (basis not stated). Official chart, stack/reach mm: XS 497/371, S 506/380, M 517/385, L 529/393.6; head angle 70–72°, seat angle 74.5–75°, chainstay 410 mm, BB drop 72 mm, wheelbase 977–993 mm. These values are identical to the NEW 2025 ARROW chart. Spec table is in Chinese on an otherwise English site. Read over HTTP, matching the site’s published links.
